semanticReview.scope: Reopened manual transport and controller lifecycle assumptions after the body-size regression: route limits, owner lifetime, duplicate leases, resume validation, terminal classification, clipboard ownership and completion TTL. Extended to actual BrowserHost UI close and initial-load/navigation/renderer failure entrypoints. Includes cancellation/completion races and superseded initial navigation. Reopened launcher-to-MCP command composition after manual mode launched native contract. Reopened adapter tool dispatch: manual runtime has no DOM observation channel. Reopened exact native manual ownership, prior abort provenance, same-turn revision and physical settlement. Mapped core tunnel command contracts and distinct runtime-key import destinations. Restored prior-boot supervisor ownership rejection across migration, publication, startup and stop.
semanticReview.remainingScope: Remaining v5 executable deltas and upstream test assertions still require granular mapping. Independent runtime review additionally identified unclosed same-version tunnel-profile migration and preflight-before-runtime-transition obligations. Existing path coverage or generic suite success does not establish parity.

obligations.behavior: Authenticated manual start accepts 3 MiB without rewriting; other controls retain 16 KiB.
Live manual owners need no Automatic heartbeat/bootstrap evidence.
Owner death removes its surface and fails both observers.
Identical retries keep the original deadline; running leases use null.
Reject malformed/empty/oversized suffix before ownership or clipboard mutation.
Preserve cancellation, timeout and failed outcomes through HTTP/client. Unlike upstream's binary classification, failed replay retains manual_turn_failed.
Clipboard failure preserves ready ownership and leaves no fresh surface. Fork writes before creation instead of upstream create-then-cleanup.
Successful completion refreshes TTL for initial and suffix turns.

Manual UI close signals cancellation before RPC and cleans up after RPC rejection without affecting siblings. Automatic close still requires acknowledgment. Terminal state becomes irreversible before RPC await; completion/start/copy cannot resurrect cancellation.

obligations.behavior: Canonicalize a manual checkpoint before any output delta. Valid trailing whitespace and latest-user marker remain accepted; ordinary final answers are unchanged.
